channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Comparing IGRA and TST for Detecting Latent Tuberculosis
item.description: A meta-analysis finds that tuberculin skin tests show higher positivity rates than interferon-gamma release assays among healthcare workers and first responders.

item.title: Lanthanide Carriers Could Advance Biomedical Imaging and Theranostics
item.description: Lanthanide carriers may drive the next generation of biomedical imaging and accelerate theranostics, which combine diagnosis and treatment.

item.title: Global Reports Reveal Widening Cancer Survival Disparities
item.description: Two global reports provide new data on cancer incidence, mortality, and disparities, with implications for U.S. oncologists.

item.title: Study Suggests Mold-Related Illnesses May Be Underrecognized
item.description: A first-of-its-kind U.S. study indicates that invasive mold infections may be an underrecognized and potentially deadly threat.
